entry.name: jit.path
entry.digest: Evaluates a series of N-dim points as a path
entry.description: The jit.path object takes a series of N-dimensional points retrieves interpolated values based on an input parameter. It is useful for creating user interfaces for parameter morphing.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autohandles
attributes.digest: Enable automatic handle calculation
attributes.description: Enable the calculation of handle values every time the path is edited (default = 1).

attributes.digest: Path duration in seconds

attributes.name: evalmatrixmode
attributes.digest: Matrix evaluation mode
attributes.description: Determines how the eval-matrix is evaluated (default = eval). In evalmatrixmode, the evaluated values are spaced using the distance between the points. In evalmatrixmode, the evaluated values are spaced evenly along the path length.

attributes.description: The eval matrix name (default = UID). This is a read-only attribute and is useful in conjunction with themessage when accessingin javascript.

messages.name: append
messages.description: Append point values to the end of the path. Ifis 0, it is set to length of arg list.

messages.name: calc_evalmatrix
messages.description: Calculate the eval matrix by filling with the evaluated values of the path. The matrix is 1D, the size is equal to the, and the planes are equal to path. Useful in conjunction with theattribute when accessingin javascript.

messages.name: calc_outmatrix
messages.description: Calculate the point output matrix by filling with the path point and handle values. The matrix is 2D with the size is equal to number of points, and planes equal to path. Useful in conjunction with theattribute when accessingin javascript.

messages.name: calchandles
messages.description: Calculate the path handles of each point in the path using the Catmull-Rom method. This will overwrite any previously stored handles.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Remove all points from the path

messages.name: closepath
messages.description: Close the path by adding a point to the end equal to the first point.

messages.name: eval
messages.description: Evaluate the path using, (between 0. and 1.) and output the interpolated values.

messages.name: evallength
messages.description: Evaluate the path using the(between 0 and) and output the interpolated values.

messages.name: evaltime
messages.description: Evaluate the path using(between 0 and) and output the interpolated values. Theattribute must be set to 1, causing the first dim of the path to be treated as time values.

messages.name: gethandle
messages.description: Get handle values atand output through dump outlet.

messages.name: getpoint
messages.description: Get the point values atand output through dump outlet..

messages.name: insert
messages.description: Insert a new point at. Index value is ignored ifis enabled.

messages.name: next
messages.description: Advance the path animation to the next point.

messages.name: outputeval
messages.description: Output a matrix from the second outlet, filled with the evaluated values of the path. The matrix is 1D, the size is equal to the, and the planes are equal to path.

messages.name: prev
messages.description: Rewind the path animation to the previous point

messages.name: settime
messages.description: Set time at. If necessary, the path will be resorted prior to evaluation.

messages.name: sorttime
messages.digest: Sort path based on time values
